label: late-position a in sequences starting with h
explanation: Very sparse feature. It fires almost only on the input token a (90% of activation mass) at late original-phase positions (orig_idx 5-7, the last 1-3 tokens before <DEL>), mostly in sequences whose first token is h (82% of mass; u is next at 13%). It never fires in the copy phase, and fires on <DEL> only rarely. The strongest examples are h ... a with a at step 5-7, often after o or e. Precision is low: most late a tokens in h-initial sequences stay silent, and requiring certain intermediate tokens (k, r, o, e) helps only a little (F1 about 0.2-0.28), so the full gating condition depends on something in the hidden state that this predicate does not capture. Including u-initial sequences and orig_idx 4 raises mass recall to 0.85 but lowers precision to about 0.05.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=h (+4.27), orig0=u (+2.70), phase=0 & in_tok=a (+2.40), recall_idx=-1 & in_tok=a (+2.40), prev_tok=e (+1.90), orig1=u (+1.85). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-2.08), phase=2 (-1.63), t=3 (-1.38), orig_idx=-1 (-1.33).
